llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam red flags: the domain is very new (registered in July 2024), has anonymized WHOIS with no visible business owner information, the 'Contact Us' page is nonfunctional (possible intent to limit communication after purchase), and legitimate-looking branded items are advertised at steep discounts across the store ('-65%', 'Black Friday 2024, 50%+'). These patterns are consistent with fake online shopping scams which often lure buyers with well-known brands, deep discounts, and lack of verifiable business details. No clear company name, address, or proper contact information is provided on the visible site. Based on these combined factors from the scam checklist, https://produitsbebes.com/ is classified as a scam.
